fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of "find" binary in a suspicious manner to perform discovery
fields.name: Potential Discovery Activity Using Find - MacOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/find" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -4000" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -2000" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm 0777" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -222" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -o w" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -o x" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -u=s" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-perm -g=s")))
